notes.title: Diamond Skee-ball Announcement
notes.content:
[b][u]We are currently running beta on the following channels for Diamond Skee-Ball.[/u][/b]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/submainfun]SubmainFun (Twitch Channel)[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/cpw_skeeball]CPW_skeeball (Twitch Channel)[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/oneira_levantas]Oneira Levantas (Twitch Channel)[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/skitsylum]Skitsylum (Twitch Channel)[/url]

Some Channels may [u]NOT[/u] be live but drop them a follow for when they do go live

[u][b]Pop on over and use the following commands:[/b][/u]

[list]
Use the command 
[*] !roll [power 1 to 5] [startingPost -5 to 5] [rotation -30 to 30]" to join the que.

[*] EG: !roll 5 5 30
[/list]

!help (this will tell you what you need to do aswell)

[h1][u][b]Add to your wishlist to be notified when we have the release open.[/b][/u][/h1]
